29:15.text: Then We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made it

29:16.text: when he said to his people: "Worship Allâh
, and fear Him: that is better for you if you did but know.

29:17.text: "You worship besides Allâh only idols, and you only invent falsehood. Verily, those whom you worship besides Allâh have no power to give you provision: so seek your provision from Allâh
, and be grateful to Him. To Him

29:18.text: "And if you deny, then nations before you have denied
. And the duty of the Messenger is only to convey

29:19.text: See they not how Allâh originates the creation, then repeats it. Verily, that is easy for Allâh.

29:20.text: Say: "Travel in the land and see how
originated the creation, and then Allâh will bring forth the creation of the Hereafter
. Verily, Allâh is Able to do all things."

29:21.text: He punishes whom He wills, and shows mercy to whom He wills; and to Him you will be returned.

29:22.text: And you cannot escape in the earth or in the heaven
. And besides Allâh you have neither any Walî

29:23.text: And those who disbelieve in the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of Allâh and the Meeting with Him, it is they who have no hope of My Mercy: and it is they who will have a painful torment.
